title: The Right to Travel: No Driver License Required In The U.S!
summary: Infowars segment claiming driver's licenses are only required for commerce, that personal travel is a right, and that the DMV is a profit-seeking corporation.

assertions.quote: if you're doing personal travel along the highways a personal transportation there's no law saying that you need a driver's license
a driver is one who is employed in conducting a vehicle a traveler is one who is on a journey of a personal nature
I'd like to read you something from state vers Spokane the right of the citizen to travel upon the highway
implemented such methods as a driver's license vehicle registration and so on to extort money from the people under color of law

verdicts.note: Licensing and registration are state safety and identification laws upheld by courts; motor vehicle agencies are state bodies, not private corporations.
The Court found the purpose was public safety and order plus compensation for costly roads, and held the statute 'is not a mere revenue measure'.
